# Tripalink

> > Tripalink is a rental housing platform offering apartments, homes, and duplexes across major U.S. cities including Houston, Bay Area, Chicago, Washington D.C., Pittsburgh, Arcadia, and Tacoma.

The platform specializes in helping renters find properties with specific amenities (washer/dryer, EV charging, elevators, wheelchair access) and price points. Tripalink serves students and young professionals near universities like UCB and UW, offering both traditional rentals and coliving spaces.

## Key Topics

- Apartment rentals and property search
- Houston, Bay Area, Chicago, and Washington D.C. markets
- Amenity-filtered searches (washer/dryer, EV charging, elevators)
- Budget-friendly and affordable housing options
- Wheelchair accessibility and ADA compliance
- Furnished apartments and utilities-included rentals
- University housing near UCB and UW
- Coliving spaces and shared housing
- Homes, apartments, and duplex listings
- Price-range filtering ($900-$1,500/month)
- Top-rated rental properties
- Arlington and Arcadia neighborhoods
